request: A window on the homepage showing live AliExpress coupons, checked and updated all the time

finding.verdict: The AliExpress Portals API exposes no coupons at all. The literal request cannot be built from real data.

methods_tested.result: InsufficientPermission - this app is not granted it
Works. Returns 139 named product feeds with promo_name, promo_desc and product_num. No codes, no discount values, no dates, and not our products.

finding.product_record: Full field dump of productdetail.get shows no coupon, code, voucher or expiry field. The only discount-shaped value is `discount`, a percentage computed against target_original_price - the permanently inflated figure the product pages already refuse to print, because 142 of 159 products carry one.

built_instead.what: A price-drop band: products whose price has fallen since we ourselves last recorded it, showing both figures and both dates
built_instead.why: It is the one discount the site can stand behind. Both numbers are ours, both are dated, and a reader can check either against the live listing.
built_instead.sorting: By money saved, not percentage. 40% off a $3 toy is not the news that 25% off a $60 bed is.
built_instead.empty_state: The band removes itself when nothing has dropped. An empty deals section beats a full one that invents deals.

first_run.note: 56 prices ROSE in a single day. That is the argument for the whole approach: any static coupon or fixed discount would have been wrong about a third of the catalogue within 24 hours.

biggest_drops.product: Automatic Tennis Ball Launcher for Dogs
Smart Self-Rolling Bounce Ball for Dogs
Waterproof Bark Control Collar with Sound and Vibration
Waterproof Anti-Leak Dog Bed Cover and Mattress Protector
Dog Dental Care Kit with Toothbrush and Paste

meta_keys._lookdog_facts_date: date the current price was recorded
meta_keys._lookdog_price_prev: the observation being compared against - written once, cleared only when the price rises again, so a slow slide reports the whole fall

schedule.chunking: 5 IDs per productdetail.get call with up to 3 retries on an empty result, per the documented rate limit
schedule.caveat: WP-Cron fires on an uncached page load and this site serves HTML from a seven-day page cache, so 04:00 is a target rather than a guarantee. DISABLE_WP_CRON is not set. If the refresh drifts, add a real cron in hPanel hitting wp-cron.php.

homepage_order: Cheaper than when we last looked
placement.grounds: photo, tint, white, tint - so no two adjacent bands share a background
placement.layout_family: Two-column board of tight rows. Distinct from the rail's horizontal cards and the category grid's cards.

verification.band: 6 rows, biggest saving first, both prices and both dates on each
verification.css: gated on the shortcode being present; band returns empty string when there are no drops
verification.links: 32 unique internal links on the homepage, all 200
verification.design: check-design passes with no violations; thumbnail radius corrected from an off-scale 6px to 4px
verification.entity: The arrow between dates is → in source and renders as an arrow - an earlier draft passed it through esc_html and would have printed the entity literally
verification.my_own_error: A verification check reported the arrow as broken because it searched the raw source for the decoded character. The markup was correct; the check was not.
